Seminole County Animal Services

Hound Around Town · Sanford, Florida

Volunteers only Open to the shelter's trained volunteers. Many shelters make it easy to become one.

Trained volunteers take a vetted dog out for 2 hours (trail walk, park, brunch at partner restaurant patios). Must be 18+ and complete a mandatory 2-hour training (see county events calendar). Mon-Fri 10am-12pm. Shelter at 232 Bush Blvd, Sanford.

Sign up on the shelter's site

Thinking of adopting? See Seminole County Animal Services on ShelterAdoption for its adoptable pets and adoption events.

Rules, hours and fees are set by the shelter and can change. Always confirm with the shelter before you go. ShelterDayOut isn't affiliated with this shelter and doesn't arrange outings.

Is something out of date? Report a problem. Work at this shelter? Claim this listing to update it or receive outing requests.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
